entries.label: MGS1 — Cargo Dock
entries.prompt: Create exactly ONE empty 2D fighting-game stage source for CQC Versus Legacy, wide landscape 16:9. This is an accurate painted-HD adaptation of Metal Gear Solid 1 (1998 PlayStation original), NOT the Twin Snakes remake. Inspect and follow the attached original-game reference for architecture, colors, materials and identifying layout. Remove all people, vehicles, HUD, text, logos, annotation arrows and map markers. No collage, no labels, no watermark. Keep a continuous horizontal combat floor across the lower quarter and a coherent readable background. No fake layer split, no spritesheet, no UI. Preserve the reference's distinctive shapes rather than replacing the location with a generic military room. LOCATION Cargo Dock, the opening underground dock inside Shadow Moses. Use the full overhead official map as the layout authority and the second opening capture only for lighting and steel texture. Translate to a side-on arena: damp blue-grey concrete quay, low dark seawater dock recess visible in the BACKGROUND/lower rear edge rather than a gap in the combat lane, cyan utilitarian lights, two dense stacks of corrugated dark cargo crates/containers at rear left and rear right, central open aisle leading to the recessed small industrial cargo lift and its overhead girders, weathered steel wall struts, pipework. Preserve the cramped, cold, covert teal atmosphere of the PS1 scene. The front fighting lane is an uninterrupted wet grey concrete strip, with subtle puddles, thin yellow-black hazard markings beside the dock, no scenery blocking feet. No characters, no title lettering from the opening capture.

notes: Architecture and palette checked against the cited original MGS1 capture/map.
Side-on combat composition is a painted HD adaptation; original camera, dimensions and hidden geometry are not reproduced pixel-for-pixel.
Single static background source; no parallax layers, collision layout or runtime admission in this pass.
